name: Gluteus maximus
dailyLifeRole: Drives you up from a chair and up stairs.

name: Gluteus medius
dailyLifeRole: Keeps your pelvis level when you stand on one leg while walking.

review.notes: Role of holding the pelvis level in single-leg stance is not in the pages read; add a source before a claim.

name: Gluteus minimus
dailyLifeRole: Works with gluteus medius to steady your hip on one leg.

review.notes: Question: the OpenStax summary I got listed an adduction-like action for this muscle, which looks wrong against standard anatomy (abduction; medial rotation is widely stated). Recorded abduction only. Check the page directly. Deep to gluteus medius, so no body-map slug.

name: Tensor fasciae latae
dailyLifeRole: Helps lift your leg forward and sideways and steadies the outer knee.

review.notes: No body-map slug sits on the outer hip.

name: Iliopsoas
dailyLifeRole: Lifts your thigh when you walk, climb stairs or sit up from lying.

review.notes: OpenStax lists psoas major and iliacus separately; merged here as one record. Deep muscle, no body-map slug. Psoas also acts on the lumbar spine (debated); not recorded.

name: Rectus abdominis
dailyLifeRole: Curls you up when you sit up from lying down.

name: External oblique
dailyLifeRole: Turns and bends your trunk, for example when you reach across.

review.notes: Which side rotates which way not recorded.

name: Internal oblique
dailyLifeRole: Turns and bends your trunk and helps you breathe out forcefully.

review.notes: Lies under external oblique; no separate body-map slug.

name: Transversus abdominis
dailyLifeRole: Squeezes your belly in, for example when you cough or breathe out hard.

review.notes: Common claims about pre-activation and spinal stability are debated; not recorded. Deep muscle, no slug.

name: Erector spinae
dailyLifeRole: Holds your back upright and straightens you up from bending.

review.notes: Three columns (iliocostalis, longissimus, spinalis) merged into one record.

name: Multifidus
dailyLifeRole: Steadies your spine segment by segment as you move.

review.notes: Deep muscle, no slug. Role as segmental stabiliser is widely stated but not in the pages read: not recorded.

name: Quadratus lumborum
dailyLifeRole: Bends your trunk to the side, for example when you carry a bag.

review.notes: Deep muscle, no slug. Hip hiking and breathing roles not recorded.
